content:
Last month, Anthropic announced plans to expand Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad, with initial access limited to Anthropic's most expensive paid plan.

As of today, Anthropic says Claude Cowork is now fully available on mobile and desktop for all paid plans.

For more details on the rollout of Anthropic's Claude Cowork mobile version, click here.

Separately, OpenAI has launched its own solution, ChatGPT Work, which is also available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and the web.
